digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation and container scope inheritance
propositions: A live `none` child is neutral in scope inheritance and contributes no paths without poisoning sibling declarations.
An undeclared live child poisons child inheritance and forces conservative unscoped fallback when no parent or citation paths exist.
Scope precedence is exact: own/cited/inherited paths yield `paths`; explicit parent `none` yields `none`; all-live-children-none promotes undeclared parent to `none`; otherwise `unscoped`.
Cheap resign must preserve the same child-derived signed scope using only immutable relation snapshot state without network reads.
P9 must pass declared-none leaves and containers where all live children are declared, advising only live undeclared children and naming both path and `--none` remedies.
